title: Photography overview

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Choose subjects and photographic tone together so images reinforce how the brand should feel.
strategic_value: Relatable people and warm everyday scenes can connect Verizon’s services to ordinary life.
demonstration: The September 17, 2019 overview combines rationale, a twelve-image lifestyle mosaic and separate subject and tone lists.
practical_value: Brief a photographer or evaluate stock imagery against both the depicted activity and the intended treatment.

content_islands.name: Rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the title and date on black, followed by the explanation of simple, relatable photography.

content_islands.name: Lifestyle mosaic
content_islands.spec: Preserve the three rows of four photographs showing people, relationships, devices and outdoor settings.

content_islands.name: Attribute lists
content_islands.spec: Use two columns below a rule, separating subject choices from tone words.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that photographic style reinforces brand tone and should reflect the brand’s core principles.
reference_purposes.Expression: The mosaic demonstrates candid, warm and naturally lit lifestyle scenes.
reference_purposes.Application: The subject and tone lists are explicitly offered for briefing photographers or selecting stock imagery.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source calls for simple photography that is not busy or cluttered and shows real people in relatable scenarios.

ingredient.name: Lifestyle photography
ingredient.role: Relate the service to recognizable people and situations.
ingredient.application: Choose simple, positive emotional images of real people in relatable scenarios; use the subject and tone lists to evaluate selections.
ingredient.scope: Photography overview updated September 17, 2019. These are the source’s art-direction criteria, not a claim that every photographed scene is documentary.
